QuestInfo.parent: A Task for a Citizen of Honor
QuestInfo.name: An Unbreakable Code
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p411# at #m10003003# has another task for me.
QuestInfo.1: #p411# at #m10003003# said there was someone who could decipher #b#t4031131##k, and told me to seek out an expert living somewhere deep in the marshland. It sounded like I could find him in a small cabin at #b#m10003097##k.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I met #p436#, an expert in code-breaking, at #m10003098#.

0.0: If we could decipher what's written in this #b#t4031132##k, we might be able to find out what happened to Rex. But it's encrypted far more intricately than it looks — not easy to make sense of. Must've used some forbidden magic for this.
0.1: Almost no one can decipher a document like this. But there's one person... someone living in seclusion deep in the marshland who can crack this kind of thing. Find him and figure out what's written in it.

yes.0: If my memory serves, his cabin should be somewhere around #b#m10003097##k. I wouldn't come back here without that document deciphered, if I were you.

no.0: Refusing a task from me? Have you lost your mind?

1.0: You actually found this cabin? Just who are you, huh? #p411# has business with someone like me? This is... #t4031132#... heh heh... Well, I suppose he's got good reason to come looking for me...

item.0: You actually found this cabin? Just who are you, huh? #p411# has business with someone like me? So, where's this document you're talking about, then?

npc.0: Deep within a small cabin at #b#m10003097##k, there's someone hiding who can decipher this #t4031132#. Go find him, now.

lost.0: I already knew you'd lost the #t4031132#. Be grateful one of my people happened to find it.
